name: JFE Systems, Inc.
summary: JFE Systems, Inc. engages in the planning, designing, developing, operating, and maintenance of information systems in Japan. The company also offers various business solutions, such as system integration, supply chain management systems, data science, AI, business system and low code development, ERP, BI, e-commerce, system coordination, digital form systems, cost management systems, procurement management systems, HR/payroll systems, and quality information management and manufacturing method management systems for the food products industry.
